units.source_text: 因為在我迄今認識的所有人中，我只喜歡那個窮酸的常子。

en.t: Because among all the people I had ever known, the only one I loved was that shabby, poor Tsuneko.

units.source_text: 房東的女兒給我寫來了一封由五十首短歌構成的長信。

en.t: The landlady's daughter sent me a long letter made up of fifty tanka poems.

units.source_text: 每首短歌的首句全是反覆重複的「為我活著吧」這樣奇怪的句式。

en.t: The first line of every tanka repeated the strange phrase, "Live for me."

units.source_text: 護士們笑容可掬到我的病房裡來玩，有的甚至總是在緊緊握過我的手之後才離去。

en.t: The nurses came smiling into my sickroom to chat, and some would not leave until they had tightly clasped my hand.

units.source_text: 醫院查出我的左肺上有毛病，這對我來說倒是好訊息。

en.t: The hospital found something wrong with my left lung, which for me was actually good news.

units.source_text: 不久，我被警察以「協助自殺罪」從醫院帶到了警察局，在那裡警察把我當作病人對待，關押在特別看守室裡。

en.t: Before long, the police took me from the hospital to the police station on the charge of assisting a suicide, and there they treated me as a sick person and confined me in a special holding room.
